final.primary_estimand: Cross-sectional age effect: older (65-71 y, n=18) vs young (19-27 y, n=20) male vastus lateralis, groups deliberately MATCHED for physical activity (ABS.p2, S1.p3, S2.2.p1). No exercise intervention, no acute bout, no active-vs-sedentary arm.
planned_contrasts: Older vs Young, DESeq2 (S2.5.p2; paper: 4327 DEGs, 3797 coding: 1891 up / 1906 down in older; S3.1.p1) - age contrast, not exercise

Within-group association of expression with continuous MVPA time, limma-voom (S2.5.p2, S3.4.p4; paper: 662 genes older, 1058 young at unadjusted P<0.05) - the only physical-activity analysis; needs per-subject MVPA
final.paper_method: DESeq2 ~ age group after removing genes with <10 reads per row; limma-voom (TMM) with MVPA as continuous covariate within each age group
final.sample_inclusion: 38 males with high-quality RNA; two older subjects excluded before deposition (S2.2.p1)

reasoning: Paper design is an age comparison under matched physical activity (S1.p3, S2.2.p1, S4.p1). Its only physical-activity analysis is a correlation with accelerometry-measured MVPA within each age group (S3.4.p4, FIG5F, Figure S3A) at raw P<0.05.

checks: all male vastus lateralis, BGISEQ-500, STAR+HTSeq matches S2.5.p1

reasoning: Data availability statement and sample counts match.
